mapper.insert: insert into task_lineage_evidence() values( #{evidence.tenantId},#{evidence.evidenceId},#{evidence.rootTaskId},#{evidence.taskId},#{evidence.parentTaskId},#{evidence.eventType}, #{evidence.originPrincipalType},#{evidence.originPrincipalId},#{evidence.actorPrincipalType},#{evidence.actorPrincipalId},#{evidence.executorAgentId},#{evidence.assignmentId}, #{evidence.departmentId},#{evidence.groupId},#{evidence.credentialId},#{evidence.oauthClientId},#{evidence.sourceSystem},#{evidence.correlationId},#{evidence.traceId}, #{evidence.failureDomain},#{evidence.failureCode},#{evidence.reason},#{evidence.occurredAt}) on conflict(tenant_id,evidence_id) do nothing
mapper.select: select from task_lineage_evidence where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and task_id=#{taskId} order by occurred_at,evidence_id limit #{limit}
select from task_lineage_evidence where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and root_task_id=#{rootTaskId} order by occurred_at,evidence_id limit #{limit}
select from task_lineage_evidence where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and executor_agent_id=#{agentId} order by occurred_at desc,evidence_id desc limit #{limit}
select from task_lineage_evidence where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and correlation_id=#{correlationId} order by occurred_at desc,evidence_id desc limit #{limit}
